howto: Pick your break with the arrow keys (Q and E change board), then press Enter or tap to surf.
Hold W to pump for speed and steer with A and D to carve across the wave.
Ride the steep face, tuck into the barrel and pump off the lip for air.
Link moves to build the combo and bank your best ride before the 80-second heat ends.
tips: Stars come from your best single ride: bank long rides, not lots of short ones.
Land airs with the board flat for a PERFECT: twice the points and the combo stays alive.
A hard flat landing from big air, or staying capsized, is a wipeout that resets the combo.
Set waves (the banner warns you) are the biggest and the only ones that barrel.
Stars unlock the harder breaks on the map; missions give each session a goal.

controls.keyboard: A / D carve, W pump, S brake, C cycles the camera, Enter starts. On the title: arrows pick a break, Q / E change board, G switches graphics quality.
controls.touch: Tap the title or results card to surf; on-screen < >, PUMP and BRAKE buttons in a heat.

difficulty: Breaks unlock with stars, from the gentle first spot to heavier reef breaks; missions climb a ladder of harder goals.

cheats.effect: The heat clock stops: surf as long as you like
No wipeouts: capsizes and flat landings don't knock you off
Every break on the map is open

tricks.name: Carve
tricks.input: Hold A or D hard at speed

tricks.name: Pocket Ride
tricks.input: Stay high on the steep face of the wave

tricks.name: Barrel
tricks.input: Tuck under the curling lip of a set wave

tricks.name: Air
tricks.input: Pump (W) up the face and fly off the lip

tricks.name: Perfect Landing
tricks.input: Land an air with the board flat

settings.quality: Press G on the title: GRAPHICS High (shadows, anti-aliasing) or Low

features.trick-system: Carves, pocket time, barrels and airs all score, with bigger labels for BIG and HUGE airs
features.trick-list: The arcade pause menu lists the seven scoring moves with their inputs
features.combo: Combo multiplier (shown under the score) builds while you keep scoring and decays after a lull
features.land-bail-feedback: PERFECT / BIG / HUGE landing pop-ups and sounds; wipeouts tumble the board, swing the camera and reset the combo
features.trick-tutorial: A four-step guided first heat (pump, carve, air, perfect landing) with Skip; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.results: HEAT COMPLETE card: stars, wave of the day, heat total, new best, top speed, combo, longest air and missions
features.restart: Restart starts the heat again with a fresh countdown
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting: no pop-up and countdown scaling or camera banking
